title: Pre-auth filters fail closed on a non-normalisable path; demo gate gates /rest/* by default; context path stripped in decoded form

criteria.then: guards the null path from RequestPaths before calling startsWith, and a test covers it
treats a null path as a SCIM path (demands a bearer), and a test covers it
gates everything under /rest/ except the info and gate allowlist and the SCIM surface
strips the context path in decoded form (so an encoded spelling of a non-root context is stripped) and fails closed when the path is outside the context, with a test
documents the TOKEN_PRINCIPAL marker as mandatory for any new token filter
